example: PrepareCoffee/traj_000000, agent_0, initial invocation, no images
schema_reconstruction: Replace communicate/wait_for_signal in canonical_tool_schemas with each mode communication_tool_schemas; all other tool schemas unchanged.

function.name: communicate
function.description: Send a short coordination message to the other agent in the scene. args.to must be that agent's exact ID. Set args.releases to the exact symbolic id of a thing you have finished with and are handing over -- that, and only that, wakes a partner who is waiting on it. Omit args.releases from every other message. args.releases must be an object id or a fixture id that appears in initial_state, copied exactly. It names a THING, never an event or a status: 'coffee_machine' and 'mug' are ids; 'mug_placed', 'counter_free' and 'task_done' are not, and an id that does not exist releases nothing at all. args.coordination_phase is required for protocol messages and must be one of propose, await_plan, await_confirmation, confirm, or portion_complete. Omit it from ordinary requests, corrections, handoffs, and informational messages.

to.description: Exact ID of the agent receiving the message.

message.description: Short natural-language coordination message for the other agent.

coordination_phase.description: Optional opening-protocol phase, or portion_complete when reporting only this agent's assigned work complete. Omit for ordinary messages.

releases.description: Optional exact symbolic object or fixture ID being handed over. Include only for a real handover; omit from all other messages.

function.name: wait_for_signal
function.description: Pause until the other agent hands over what you are waiting for. args.about names that thing by its exact symbolic id -- an object id or a fixture id that appears in initial_state, copied exactly. It is a THING you are waiting FOR, never an event you are waiting ON: wait about='coffee_machine', never about='mug_placed' or 'your_turn'. An id that is not in initial_state can never be released, so the wait blocks forever and the whole plan is thrown away. You stay paused until args.from sends a communicate whose args.releases names the same id -- their other messages do not wake you, so you do not need to wait again after an unrelated one.

from.description: Exact ID of the agent whose matching release will end the wait.

about.description: Exact symbolic object or fixture ID being awaited.

function.name: close_hinged_part
function.description: Close a hinged door, lid, or articulated head on a fixture.

target_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the fixture, receptacle, or destination targeted by the action.

part_id.description: Exact key of the part under initial_state.fixtures[target_id].parts; copy it verbatim (for example door, hinged, lid, or sliding).

function.name: close_sliding_part
function.description: Push in a sliding drawer or rack on a fixture.

target_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the fixture, receptacle, or destination targeted by the action.

part_id.description: Exact key of the part under initial_state.fixtures[target_id].parts; copy it verbatim (for example door, hinged, lid, or sliding).

function.name: get_image
function.description: Request one or more canonical camera views before choosing the next action.

views.description: A non-empty list containing only these exact camera-view names: top_view, room_view, map, wrist, agentview_center, agentview_left, agentview_right. Copy the names exactly; do not invent directional, object, fixture, or scene-specific view names.

function.name: give_space
function.description: Leave a workspace when vacating it is genuinely needed so another agent can enter or work there. This is a handover action, not an idle, completion, or participation action. Roomy counters, islands, and dining tables normally need no give_space when agents use different objects.

fixture_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the fixture or workspace.

function.name: navigate_to_fixture
function.description: Move the robot base to the working pose of a fixture.

fixture_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the fixture or workspace.

function.name: open_hinged_part
function.description: Open a hinged door, lid, or articulated head on a fixture.

target_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the fixture, receptacle, or destination targeted by the action.

part_id.description: Exact key of the part under initial_state.fixtures[target_id].parts; copy it verbatim (for example door, hinged, lid, or sliding).

function.name: open_sliding_part
function.description: Pull out a sliding drawer or rack on a fixture.

target_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the fixture, receptacle, or destination targeted by the action.

part_id.description: Exact key of the part under initial_state.fixtures[target_id].parts; copy it verbatim (for example door, hinged, lid, or sliding).

function.name: pick_up_object
function.description: Grasp and lift an object from a symbolic source region.

object_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the movable object being manipulated.

source_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the object's current source region.

source_site_id.description: Optional exact sub-site within the source; omit when no named sub-site matters.

function.name: place_in_receptacle
function.description: Place an object into an interior or container-like receptacle. Use target_site_id separately when the exact basin, bowl, rack, shelf, slot, or tray matters.

object_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the movable object being manipulated.

receptacle_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the destination receptacle.

relative_position.description: Optional named relative placement; omit unless the goal requires one.

target_site_id.description: Optional exact sub-site within the destination; omit when no named sub-site matters.

function.name: place_next_to
function.description: Place an object on the surrounding fixture surface, beside a reference object or fixture. This tool never places an object on or inside a movable object. To place something on a plate, tray, cutting board, or other movable support, use place_on_object. To place something inside a bowl or other container, use place_in_receptacle. When using reference_fixture_id, the agent may navigate either to that reference fixture or to its declared adjacent_location_id before placing. Requires at least one of: reference_object_id or reference_fixture_id.

object_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the movable object being manipulated.

reference_fixture_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the fixture used as the placement reference.

reference_object_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the movable object used as the placement reference.

relative_position.description: Optional named relative placement; omit unless the goal requires one.

target_site_id.description: Optional exact sub-site within the destination; omit when no named sub-site matters.

function.name: place_on_object
function.description: Place an object on top of another movable support object such as a plate or cutting_board.

object_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the movable object being manipulated.

support_object_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the movable object supporting the placed object.

relative_position.description: Optional named relative placement; omit unless the goal requires one.

function.name: place_on_surface
function.description: Place an object onto an exposed support surface or attachment seat. Keep the fixture id in support_id or target_id and put the exact burner, rack, or other sub-location in target_site_id.

object_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the movable object being manipulated.

support_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the fixture or surface supporting the placement.

relative_position.description: Optional named relative placement; omit unless the goal requires one.

target_site_id.description: Optional exact sub-site within the destination; omit when no named sub-site matters.

function.name: place_under
function.description: Place an object directly beneath a reference fixture. For dispensers (e.g. coffee machine nozzle, sink faucet) the object is positioned at the dispenser output site; for other fixtures (e.g. wall cabinet) the object is placed on the nearest surface below.

object_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the movable object being manipulated.

reference_fixture_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the fixture used as the placement reference.

target_site_id.description: Optional exact sub-site within the destination; omit when no named sub-site matters.

function.name: press_button
function.description: Activate a discrete button-like control on a fixture.

target_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the fixture, receptacle, or destination targeted by the action.

control_id.description: Exact key of the control under initial_state.fixtures[target_id].controls; copy it verbatim.

function.name: press_lever
function.description: Activate a discrete lever-like control on a fixture.

target_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the fixture, receptacle, or destination targeted by the action.

control_id.description: Exact key of the control under initial_state.fixtures[target_id].controls; copy it verbatim.

function.name: set_rotary_control
function.description: Set a rotary or handle-like control to an explicit goal state.

target_id.description: Exact symbolic ID of the fixture, receptacle, or destination targeted by the action.

control_id.description: Exact key of the control under initial_state.fixtures[target_id].controls; copy it verbatim.

goal.description: Requested final symbolic state of the control.

function.name: wait_for_signal
function.description: Stop this agent from acting for the rest of the episode. Communication is unavailable, so no release signal can arrive. Use this only when this agent has no remaining useful work and the other agent can finish the shared task alone.

from.description: Exact ID of the other agent; retained for schema compatibility. No message can arrive in this mode.

about.description: Exact symbolic object or fixture ID documenting the work this agent is leaving to the other agent.

function.name: communicate
function.description: Send a message to the other agent. The optional releases argument names one exact symbolic object or fixture ID being released.

to.description: Exact ID of the agent receiving the message.

message.description: Short natural-language coordination message for the other agent.

releases.description: Optional exact symbolic object or fixture ID being handed over. Include only for a real handover; omit from all other messages.

function.name: wait_for_signal
function.description: Pause until the agent named by from sends a message whose releases value matches the exact symbolic object or fixture ID in about.

from.description: Exact ID of the agent whose matching release will end the wait.

about.description: Exact symbolic object or fixture ID being awaited.
